source_payload_hash_scope: Exact official HTML response-body bytes returned on the access date.
retention: Only release identifiers, dates, and README branch labels needed to establish the version boundary are retained; no archive, score row, or descriptive page prose is copied.
license_or_terms: Public release metadata only; dbNSFP data terms are recorded in the separately retained license snapshot.
sanitization: Navigation, release notes, links, analytics markup, and all unrelated HTML were discarded.
